sentences.text:
Kartick Chandra Saha vs State Of West Bengal on 17 January,
2023

Author: Bibek Chaudhuri
Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri

Form J(1) In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side

Present :
The Hon'ble Justice Bibek Chaudhuri
 Crr 3744 of 2022
 Kartick Chandra Saha
 Vs.
 State of West Bengal
For the petitioner : Mr. Mirza Firoj Ahmed Begg, Adv.
 Mr. Girish Chandra Gupta, Adv.,
 Mr. Arun Naskar, Adv.

For the State : Mr. Aniket Mitra, Adv.
Judgement on : 17.01.2023.

Bibek Chaudhuri, J.
This is an application for a direction upon the Trial Court for expeditious disposal of Gr Case No.
5019/2012 arising out of Jagaddal Police Station Fir No. 801/2012 dated 30 th November, 2012
under Sections 498A/323 of the Indian Penal Code.
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that Police submitted charge-sheet in the
. On 23rd November, 2015 the Trial Court framed charge against the accused persons under Sections 498A/323 of the Indian Penal Code.
During the span of seven years, the Trial Court could only examine two witnesses out of seven charge-sheeted witnesses.

Under such circumstances, the learned Magistrate is directed to examine the remaining witnesses within four months from the date of this order and come to logical conclusion of the case within one month thereafter.
The instant revision is, thus, disposed of.
The petitioner is at liberty to act on the server copy of the order.
